===== BEGIN H35_design.txt =====
H35 frozen 2026-11-18 23:29:22 UTC. Incremental FINAL Job22 count13 patch SHA256 f4c3dc878b3d8f54a89d6c2d4143afbb45e58f233bf0e9dfcf2d32e24dbb8ab1.
Unit: one completed record_null_move transition with current BoardContext. Missing context is separately counted skipped, never a match. Parent search installs/restores BoardContext; inspected callsite invokes record_null_move before make_null_move, and piece counts are invariant under null anyway.
Actual body executes once inside lambda, including early v3 return. Child corr_valid compared with parent. Only when material bit8 valid, child's copied material index compared with fresh hash from current Board piece counts, not parent index as oracle. Invalid material payload is not semantically compared and has its own class. Existing nonpawn/mix payloads are outside this hunk's new comparison.
Old null markers entered_null=true,diff_known=true,dirty.count=0 checked. Backend reference is original nnue::v3::active(), not an enabled conjunction: original record_null_move did not check enabled. Cached v3 dispatch compared, selected v3 validity slot zero expected, unselected legacy accumulator/PSQT validity preserved; legacy path expects accumulator/PSQT false and any existing unselected v3 slot unchanged. Diagnostic reads v3 slot only when state exists and index in bounds. Actual code and production access remain unchanged.
WRONG14 sets private expected entered_null=false only White. This is synthetic metadata control, not an injected material-index or backend-invalidity fault. Classes White/Black, material-valid/invalid and v3/legacy each partition uses. Does not prove pointer identity/reload races, validity of every cache producer, NNUE numerical output or arbitrary future missing-context callers. Private reference uses shared Board/hash arithmetic but bypasses parent cached material value. No extra NNUE evaluation, no old counted hooks, no actual double mutation.

===== END H35_design.txt =====

+#endif

+#endif

     child->corr_mat_idx = ss->corr_mat_idx;

===== BEGIN H52_design.txt =====
H52 source opened kF src/search.cpp3383-3394: cached fast_single_node_stop eligibility assignment AND changed use_v3_eval backend-expression initialization. One diagnostic use per reached initialization in supported sole-main/no-parent, one configured worker, MultiPV1, nonponder, nonemergency, untimed-input domain. Untimed means limits.infinite or both movetime_ms/time_ms negative; actual allocation gives infinite priority while preserving node budget. Searches returning before this point do not count. Unsupported modes are separate skips, not matches.
Eligibility contract reference is derived from original SearchLimits rather than copying the production assignment conjunction. Within supported domain expected node flag is nodes_specified OR nonzero nodes; expected budget is input nodes, multiplied by4 with uint64 saturation for positive softnodes. Compare actual fast flag, produced node flag/budget, and expected zero hard/soft time limits, false time_managed and empty-reserve flags. The original engine had no fast eligibility flag: this is a scoped producer contract check, not an old-field oracle. It does not prove cached eligibility remains valid throughout the search or cover concurrent/helper/parent/MultiPV/timed/emergency behavior.
The same tuple compares actual use_v3_eval with genuine old expression nnue::enabled && nnue::available() && nnue::v3::active() when V3 compiled, false otherwise. APIs are queried only, with no extra evaluation or backend-state change. This overlaps earlier snapshot evidence but is specifically at initialization, not every evaluation.
Classes White/Black, no_budget/hard_nodes/soft_nodes, fast_enabled/fast_disabled, and v3/other_backend each partition supported uses. MultiPV is outside supported domain and separately counted as skipped. WRONG14 flips private expectedfast Boolean only White-to-move initializations. K2 depth-only tests a synthetic expected eligibility fault in ordinary false-flag class; normal S2 provides enabled-fast initialization observations if reached. No backend control fault, no runtime state changed.
References share request interpretation, arithmetic and NNUE APIs; not independent backend correctness or scheduler proof. Old23 counter values and complete canonical last-info fields except time/nps must remain identical per search. No native counted run used to select this design.

===== END H52_design.txt =====

===== BEGIN H52_cross_review.txt =====
H52 read-only review 2026-11-18 23:30 UTC.
Opened original r15d search.cpp2647-2684 and staging initialization hook after fast_single_node_stop_/use_v3_eval assignment. Under sole-main/no-parent/singlePV/untimed/nonponder/nonemergency restriction, original request implies node-limit flag specified-or-nonzero, original node budget or saturated four-times soft budget, no time limits/reserve/time management. Fast eligibility therefore equals presence of node budget. Independent input-derived expectation is not a copy of cached eligibility conjunction. Fresh v3 dispatch includes enabled&&available&&v3::active, matching original root selection.
White-only private expected-fast toggle leaves actual initialization and counters unchanged. Unsupported configuration skips separate, not matches. Hook only counts reached initialization point; early terminal/book/emergency exits outside. It does not compare soft_node_limit_ field, every root-reset field, backend pointer identity or dynamic option races. No full limit-state equivalence claim. No source edits or native experiment in review.
